program_directory.meaning: Trusted administrators/SYSTEM/TrustedInstaller maintain files; service and Users read/execute only.

data_directory.meaning: Protected inheritance; trusted maintainers full control, service read/traverse, no ordinary user ACE.

configuration_files.meaning: Service cannot maintain configuration or signer pin; approved high operator reads through BA, not an ordinary SID allow ACE.

state_directories.meaning: Only trusted maintainers/service read/write; service Modify excludes WRITE_DAC and WRITE_OWNER; protects new WAL/SHM/journal/audit/temp children.

scm_service.name: AgentNexusCredential
scm_service.meaning: Ordinary user/service may query config/status/descriptor only; no CHANGE_CONFIG/START/STOP/DELETE/WRITE_DAC/WRITE_OWNER.

named_pipe.name: \\.\pipe\AgentNexus.Credential.v1
named_pipe.meaning: Exact current source descriptor. No operator SID/Everyone/Authenticated Users/Users broad-write ACE. High no-write-up; not a blanket no-read-up assertion.

application_method: Create only absent roots atomically with supplied descriptor; set protected child descriptors within that root, re-open no-follow and verify final paths/owners/ACLs. Halt on existing/reparse roots. No ACL changes on C:\, Program Files or ProgramData parents.
